title: How far can routine process records predict final turbidity in industrial beer crossflow filtration? A capability-boundary study on 5000 production batches
summary: Across 5,000 brewery batches, models using routine process records explained at most about 8% of held-out turbidity variance; no nonlinear model beat linear baselines and a learning curve plateaued near R²=.10. This is a specific industrial observability/capability result, bounded to the recorded features and production setting; it is not a causal intervention result.
